name: std-learn-estimate
description: Generic estimation drill — a config-declared prompt roster asks for a quantity, the learner commits an estimate on a slider and locks it in, and the guess is graded by relative-error band: within the exact band scores full points, within the close band partial, outside none, with the true answer and the learner's percentage error revealed after each lock-in and a running score across the round. All vocabulary and bands are config-declared, so the same mechanism serves any quantitative intuition: orders of magnitude, unit conversions, historical dates, population sizes, physical constants, probabilities. Standalone by default; behind a lab router set matchMode and it renders only when MODE_SELECTED matches.

emits.description: The verdict of a lock-in: which error band the estimate landed in (exact, close, off), the guess, the truth, and the running score — a composed listener (coach, grader) can subscribe; a harmless no-op when the atom runs standalone.
emits.synonyms: estimation, order of magnitude, guess the number, error band, quantitative intuition

events.name: Mode Selected
events.description: Lab router broadcast naming the active mode; this instrument renders when the mode equals matchMode, otherwise renders null.

events.name: Set Estimate
events.description: Learner moved the estimate slider — value is the current guess, not yet graded.

events.name: Lock In
events.description: Learner committed the current estimate; it is graded against the true answer by relative-error band.

events.name: Next
events.description: Learner advanced to the next prompt after a lock-in; past the last prompt this completes the round.

events.name: Retry
events.description: Learner restarted the round from the first prompt with a cleared score.

events.name: Estimate Judged
events.description: The verdict of a lock-in: which error band the estimate landed in (exact, close, off), the guess, the truth, and the running score — a composed listener (coach, grader) can subscribe; a harmless no-op when the atom runs standalone.
events.synonyms: estimation, order of magnitude, guess the number, error band, quantitative intuition

events.name: Prompt Advanced
events.description: The learner moved to the next prompt (or completed the round) with the running score.

events.name: Round Restarted
events.description: The learner restarted the round from scratch.

events.name: Learn Round Complete
events.description: Fired once when the round finishes (advancing past the final prompt) — the standard learning completion broadcast a celebration/progression sibling (fx cues, badges) rides.
